description.en-US: LastWave is a native Android music streaming app engineered for audiophiles. It delivers studio-quality Hi-Res Lossless FLAC (up to 24-bit/192kHz) and Opus playback, offline downloads with full embedded metadata, kinetic real-time synchronized lyrics, smart algorithmic playlist generation, and automatic scrobbling across all your devices. Built around Material 3 Expressive with an uncompromising audio fidelity pipeline: bit-perfect USB DAC output, FFmpeg software decoding for every supported codec, and Android Auto support. Features * Hi-Res Lossless FLAC streaming (up to 24-bit/192kHz) and Opus playback * Bit-perfect USB DAC output routing * Real-time kinetic synced lyrics (LRCLIB) * Offline downloads with embedded metadata and cover art * Smart algorithmic playlist generation * Last.fm scrobbling across devices * Android Auto and Cast support * Home-screen Now Playing widget About this repository This custom F-Droid repo redistributes the official release APKs so that F-Droid and Droid-ify users can install and auto-update LastWave. APKs are byte-identical to the upstream GitHub Releases (same signing certificate). Versions before 3.3.1 used a different signing key and are not included.
